issues.title: Due dates drop the day outside the current year
issues.detail: The inbox Due date column shows 'Apr 2025' and 'Dec 2025' for past-year bills but 'Jan 17' for a current-year one; Scheduled shows 'Jun 2027 / May 2027'. The same bill reads 'Apr 19, 2025' in its panel, and the pay flow uses 'Sep 25, 2026'. Month-only dates hide the exact day an overdue bill was due.
issues.evidence: DOM text of inbox due-date cells: 'Apr 2025', 'Dec 2025', 'Jan 17'; bill panel button 'Due date Apr 19, 2025'; Scheduled cells 'Jun 2027' / 'May 2027'; pay-flow Send on input value 'Sep 25, 2026'.

issues.title: The same bill amount flips between positive and negative
issues.detail: Inbox rows and the bill panel show outstanding bills as positive ('$220.00'), while Needs Approval, Scheduled, Paid and the approval panel show them negative ('−$5,000.00', '−$37.19'). The pay-flow review then shows the same payment positive again ('$220.00').
issues.evidence: Row text: inbox 'Debug LLC $220.00'; approvals 'Jason Green −$5,000.00'; approval panel '−$5,000.00' (x2); scheduled '−$1.99', '−$37.19'; paid '−$5,250.00'; pay review '$220.00' (34px hero + two 16px rows).

issues.title: Cents are superscript in tables but flat in cards and review
issues.detail: Tables and panels render cents as a smaller raised span ('$220.00' with a 10.95px '.00'), while the summary cards, pay-flow review and success cards, and the recurring schedule print flat cents at full size.
issues.evidence: Inbox amount cell markup '$220.00', superscript span 10.95px vs 15px dollars; summary card '$22,272.18' is one 15px SPAN; review '$220.00' is one SPAN at 34px and 16px with no cents span.

issues.title: Overdue badge loses its warning color on row hover/selection
issues.detail: The orange Overdue badge turns neutral lavender when its row is hovered or selected, so the status color disappears exactly when the user focuses the row.
issues.evidence: Hovered row (tr:hover true) badge: color rgb(221,221,229), background rgba(141,164,245,0.28); other rows: color rgb(252,155,111), background rgba(252,155,111,0.2); badge 20px tall, radius 4px, padding 0 8px, text 12px/400 Arcadia Text.

issues.title: Due date picker overflows the viewport
issues.detail: In the bill panel edit mode the calendar popover opens to the right and is clipped: the Saturday column and the next-month arrow sit off screen at 1440px width.
issues.evidence: Calendar popup wrapper x=1122, right=1492, width=370; inner calendar x=1146, right=1468; window.innerWidth=1440.

issues.title: Four different validation patterns in one area
issues.detail: Errors appear as a tooltip-only message on a warning icon (forwarding email), inline 12px text ('Must be a dollar value.', 'Please complete this field'), inline 15px text ('Please complete all fields') and a toast (file too small). The forwarding email error is invisible unless the icon is hovered.
issues.evidence: Forwarding email: only a triangle-exclamation icon, 'Please enter a valid email address' appears in the DOM only on hover; bill edit 'Must be a dollar value.' SPAN 12px/18px rgb(252,146,180); recipient 'Please complete this field' SPAN 12px/18px plus a 'Flag error?' chip; line items 'Please complete all fields' SPAN 15px/24px rgb(252,146,180); upload 'One or more files are too small to upload, minimum 1KB per file.' inside _toastContainer.

issues.title: Three unrelated empty-state styles
issues.detail: Needs Approval and filtered Inbox use a centered title over a blurred skeleton table, Ready to Export adds two CTA buttons, and an emptied Inbox shows a pixel-font 'All your bills are paid!' card in Silkscreen. The pixel card also says bills are paid when they were deleted.
issues.evidence: Needs Approval empty: H3 'No pending approvals' Arcadia Text 17px/400 white, centered, P 14px rgb(195,195,204) over a blurred skeleton; emptied inbox: H3 'All your bills are paid!' font-family 'Silkscreen, monospace, sans-serif' 17px, letter-spacing -1px, shown right after deleting all 3 bills; Ready to Export empty adds 'Export' and 'Review Sync Errors' buttons.

issues.title: Payment method named differently per tab
issues.detail: Scheduled uses 'ACH', 'Check', 'Intl. Wire'; Paid uses 'Mercury ACH Payment', 'Check Payment', 'Domestic Wire', 'Intl. Wire'; the payment method dropdown says 'International Wire'.
issues.evidence: Method cells Scheduled: 'Check', 'ACH', 'Intl. Wire'; Paid: 'Mercury ACH Payment', 'Intl. Wire', 'Check Payment', 'Domestic Wire'; Payment method option 'International Wire 1-3 business days'.

issues.title: Timestamps use three formats
issues.detail: The sync error drawer shows 'Sep 21 at 5:10PM' and 'Sync failed on Sep 22 at 05:10 PM.' one above the other; GL code settings show 'Uploaded at 05:12 PM PDT, Sep 24, 2026' (time first, with zone).
issues.evidence: Sync error drawer leaf text 'Sep 21 at 10:08PM' (12px) above 'Sync failed on Sep 22 at 10:08 PM.' (14px); GL codes settings 'Uploaded at 10:11 PM PDT, Sep 24, 2026'.

issues.title: Same date shown as 'Yesterday' and 'Sep 23' in one panel
issues.detail: The approval panel says 'Requested by Alice C. on Sep 23' and lists Invoice date and Added on as 'Yesterday'. The inbox bill panel uses absolute dates ('Added on Sep 14', 'Invoice date Apr 18, 2025').
issues.evidence: Approval panel text: 'Requested by Alice C. on Sep 23', 'Invoice date / Yesterday', 'Added on / Yesterday', 'Send on / Oct 3'; bill panel 'Added on / Sep 14', 'Invoice date / Apr 18, 2025'.

issues.title: Title Case and sentence case mixed for the same labels
issues.detail: 'Bill Pay settings' vs 'Accounting Settings'; the 'Automation settings' tab opens an 'Automation Settings' heading; the banner button 'Review sync errors' becomes 'Review Sync Errors' on Ready to Export; rule table says 'Bank Description' while the picker says 'Bank description'; Accounting workbench tabs are Title Case ('Needs Review', 'Ready to Export', 'Sync Error') while Accounting Settings tabs are sentence case ('GL codes', 'Categorization rules'); plus 'Refresh Sync Status', 'My Transactions', 'Review Requests' next to 'Request documents'.
issues.evidence: h2 'Bill Pay settings' vs h1 'Accounting Settings'; tab 'Automation settings' vs h2 'Automation Settings'; button 'Review sync errors' (Needs Review) vs 'Review Sync Errors' (Ready to Export); cell 'Bank Description' vs select value 'Bank description'; tabs 'Needs Review999+' / 'Ready to Export' / 'Sync Error3' vs 'GL codes' / 'Categorization rules' / 'Automation settings'; buttons 'Refresh Sync Status' (Exported), 'Review Requests' (Needs Approval), 'Request documents' (pay success).

issues.title: Account and routing numbers unmasked on review
issues.detail: The recipient step masks bank details ('Account ••6789 · Routing ••0021'), but the review step prints the full account number 158856789 and routing 021000021.
issues.evidence: Recipient step text 'Account ••6789 · Routing ••0021'; review section 'Account no. / 158856789', 'Routing no. / 021000021' (the From account on the same page stays masked: 'Checking ••103').

issues.title: Decline has no confirmation while other destructive actions do
issues.detail: Decline in the approval panel removes the request immediately with only a toast; Cancel payment and Delete each open a confirmation dialog first.
issues.evidence: Clicking 'Decline' in the approval panel: 0 visible [role=dialog], request removed and the tab switches to 'No pending approvals'; bulk Delete opens dialog 'Delete items? … Delete 3 items', rule delete opens 'Delete categorization rule?'.

issues.title: Paid bill stays in the inbox and counts do not update
issues.detail: After scheduling the Debug LLC payment the bill stays in the inbox as Overdue, it does not appear in Scheduled (still 3 rows), and summary cards stay at 7 outstanding / $22,272.18 while the Ops / Payroll balance drops by $220. Deleting all three overdue bills leaves the Overdue card at 3 / $13,110.00 and the breakdown still says '3 Inbox'.
issues.evidence: Before: Ops / Payroll $2,023,267.12, row 'Apr 2025 Overdue Debug LLC $220.00'; after 'Back to Bill Pay': balance $2,023,047.12, row still present, 'Scheduled 3' with the same 3 rows, card '7 Total outstanding $22,272.18'. After 'Delete 3 items': inbox empty but cards '6 Total outstanding 3 Inbox · 3 Scheduled', '3 Overdue $13,110.00'.

issues.title: 'Manage' link looks like body text
issues.detail: In Bill Pay settings the 'Manage' link for email alerts uses the paragraph color with no underline, while the sibling 'Edit' and 'Connect' links are blue.
issues.evidence: 'Manage' A: 14px/400 rgb(195,195,204), text-decoration none; sibling 'Edit' (approval rules) and 'Connect' A: 15px/400 rgb(141,164,245).

issues.title: Icon buttons and tabs lack accessible names/roles
issues.detail: The row trash button has no aria-label or title, and the Inbox / Needs Approval / Scheduled / Paid tabs (and Accounting tabs) are clickable DIVs with no tab role.
issues.evidence: Row delete button <button class="_button_r6b2u_20 _small_r6b2u_72 _destructive_r6b2u_186"> with aria-label null, title '' and only svg[data-icon=trash][aria-hidden=true]; tabs are DIV with role=null (snapshot 'generic "Inbox 3"', 'generic "Sync Error3"'); bill edit amount input's only name is its placeholder '0.00'.

issues.title: Email receipt field does not match sibling inputs
issues.detail: On the Details step the 'Email receipt to' multi-select is taller, has less left padding and a brighter text color than the inputs above it, so its placeholder is misaligned.
issues.evidence: Email receipt combobox: wrapper 42px, input padding-left 4px, color rgb(255,255,255); Invoice/Memo inputs: wrapper 40px, padding-left 12px (or 0 inside a padded wrapper), color rgb(221,221,229).

issues.title: Currency inputs align and format differently
issues.detail: The same $220 bill amount is edited in three currency inputs that do not match: the bill panel shows '220.00', the Amount step shows '220' left-aligned, and the line-item Unit price shows '220' right-aligned.
issues.evidence: Bill panel edit input[placeholder='0.00'] value '220.00'; Amount step input[name^=amount] value '220', placeholder '0.00', text-align start; line item input[name^=lineitem-amount] value '220', placeholder '0.00', text-align right; all 15px.

issues.title: Create recipient shown as a link in one state and a button in another
issues.detail: With a matched recipient, 'Create recipient' is an underlined inline link; with no match it is a full-width 50px secondary button.
issues.evidence: No-match: BUTTON height 50px, width 560px, radius 8px, background rgba(180,183,200,0.12); matched: BUTTON 20px tall, color rgb(141,164,245), text-decoration underline, font-size 13.3333px (browser default, not the 15px body size).

issues.title: Invoice date input labeled as due date
issues.detail: In bill edit mode both date inputs use the placeholder/accessible name 'Select due date', including the Invoice date field.
issues.evidence: Edit-mode inputs: input[placeholder='Select due date'] value 'Apr 19, 2025' (Due date) and input[placeholder='Select due date'] value 'Apr 18, 2025' (Invoice date); amount input named only by placeholder '0.00'.

issues.title: Hidden 'Upload an attachment' heading precedes every pay-flow step
issues.detail: The drag-and-drop overlay's h2 'Upload an attachment' sits in the accessibility tree on every pay-flow step, before the visible step title, so screen readers announce it as the page's first heading.
issues.evidence: Snapshot on /send-money/pay/recipient-match: heading 'Upload an attachment' [level=2] then heading 'Recipient match' [level=1]; the h2 is inside ._fullScreenOverlay with opacity 0 and pointer-events none, no aria-hidden.

issues.title: Date filter says 'All time' but shows a start date
issues.detail: The Accounting Filters panel shows 'All time' selected while the From field reads 'Jun 17, 2026'.
issues.evidence: Filters panel: select value 'All time'; input 'Start date' value 'Jun 17, 2026'; 'End date' value 'Today'.

issues.title: GL Code column clipped in the accounting table
issues.detail: The GL Code picker is cut off by the sticky Actions column, showing '215 - A' and 'Mercur' with no ellipsis.
issues.evidence: GL Code header left=1258px, width=240px (position static); Actions header left=1330px, width=110px, position sticky, leaving ~72px of GL Code visible; cells read 'Mercur' on the Sync Error tab.

issues.title: Different sort indicators in Bill Pay and Accounting tables
issues.detail: Bill Pay's 'Last updated' header uses a chevron-down, Accounting's 'Date (PDT)' header uses a filled caret.
issues.evidence: Bill Pay th 'Last updated' svg data-icon='chevron-down'; Accounting th 'Date (PDT)' svg data-icon='caret-down'.

issues.title: Amount rules print the comparison operator twice
issues.detail: In the rules table each condition has a connector chip ('has', '=', '>') that fades in on hover. Text rules read 'has AWS', but amount rules already prefix the value with the operator, so the row reads '> > $500.00' and '< < $2,000.00' when hovered and in its accessible name.
issues.evidence: Condition cell accessible text 'has AWS', '> > $500.00', '= Facebook < < $2,000.00'; first '>' SPAN sits in ._connectorBadge with opacity 0 (1 on row hover), second '>' is part of the 15px amount text.

issues.title: Bill Pay shows tomorrow’s date while Accounting shows today
issues.detail: With the browser in Pacific time on Sep 24 at 10:11 PM, Bill Pay stamps everything Sep 25 (Last updated, Paid on, default Send on) while Accounting says 'Uploaded at 10:11 PM PDT, Sep 24, 2026' and the recipient card says 'Last paid on Sep 24, 2026'. Bill Pay appears to format dates in UTC without saying so; Accounting labels its column 'Date (PDT)'.
issues.evidence: Browser Date(): 'Thu Sep 24 2026 22:11 GMT-0700 (PDT)'; inbox 'Last updated' cells 'Sep 25'; Paid rows 'Sep 25'; Send on input 'Sep 25, 2026'; GL codes 'Uploaded at 10:11 PM PDT, Sep 24, 2026'; recipient match 'Last paid on Sep 24, 2026'.

issues.title: Feedback button is built from the status badge
issues.detail: The Feedback control next to the Bill Pay title uses the same badge component as the Overdue status (20px, 4px radius, 12px text), while the header actions beside it are 32px pill buttons. It reads as a label, not a button.
issues.evidence: Feedback BUTTON height 20px containing SPAN._badge (background rgba(119,190,207,0.2), radius 4px, padding 0 8px) and 12px text; 'Upload bill' BUTTON 32px, radius 9999px, padding 4px 16px 4px 12px, 15px text; Overdue badge 20px, radius 4px, padding 0 8px, 12px.
